title: Qwen3.8 27B IQ3_XXS (f16 KV, 32K) on one RTX 5060 Ti 16GB
purpose: Experimental single-card Qwen3.8 route with f16 KV at 32K, as a quality comparison against the recommended q8 KV 64K route.
caveats: Retrieval fit checks passed and the f16 KV route fit in ~14.3GB, but both sustained runs exhausted the 1536-token output budget in hidden reasoning without reaching the required client-visible output.
Capable/experimental, not recommended. The q8 KV 64K route is the published single-card Qwen3.8 preset.
